basic_details.job_title: Collector Office Bharuch Additional Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Advocates who have been active in practice for at least seven years, are aged between 30 and 55 years and have been income tax payers for at least 3 years can apply for 9 Additional Public Prosecutor posts at the Bharuch District Court. The Office of the Collector and District Magistrate (Collector ane Jilla Magistrate ni Kacheri), Bharuch is preparing a panel for these posts; the application form is on the office website bharuch.nic.in and must be sent only by Speed Post so that it reaches the office by 23 November 2026. Appointees receive fees and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecut

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the office website bharuch.nic.in (the same format is printed in the notice, addressed to the District Magistrate, Bharuch, with the subject "Regarding appointment of Additional Public Prosecutor").
Fill in complete details in the form and affix a recent passport-size photograph, signed by the candidate, in the box given.
Attach certified copies of the certificates of date of birth, experience and educational qualification.
Attach the income tax returns of the last three years.
List the attached certified copies in the enclosures table (serial numbers 1 to 10) at the end of the form.

Send the application form only by Speed Post to the Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, District Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001, so that it reaches the office by 23 November 2026.
Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will not be considered.
Name with surname, present address and permanent address, telephone and mobile number.
Date of birth and age on the date of application (birth certificate to be attached), place of birth, nationality and mother tongue.
Educational qualification, and the date and details of passing the law graduate or equivalent examination.
Date of registration as an advocate under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961 (copy of the Sanad to be attached).
Date and court from which practice started (certificate from that court to be attached), and total practice up to the date of the advertisement.
Year-wise annual income and income tax paid for the last three years (copies of filed returns must be attached).
Whether any police case is registered or any court case is pending against the applicant, with details.
Criminal cases conducted in the last three years, how many succeeded and in how many an appeal was filed; and any earlier or current service as Additional Public Prosecutor with dates.
Recent passport-size photograph signed by the candidate
Certified copy of the date of birth certificate
Certified copies of educational qualification certificates
Copy of the Sanad (registration as advocate)
Certificate from the court where practice started, and experience proof
Copies of income tax returns filed for the last three years
Proofs of any other qualification claimed

content_sections.heading: About Collector Office Bharuch
content_sections.text: The Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Bharuch functions from the First Floor, District Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001 (phone 02642-243751, email [email protected] ). Acting on instructions in the Home Department circular No. HD/MIS/e-file/8/2026/3525/L-1 dated 17 July 2026, the Government has decided to form a panel to fill a total of 9 Additional Public Prosecutor posts at the Bharuch District Court. The panel is being prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and the Government's Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules, 2026. The notice is signed by Dr. Navnath Gavhane, District Magistrate, Bharuch.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from law graduates who meet all of the following conditions laid down in the notice: Active as an advocate for at least seven years. Not less than 30 years of age and not more than 55 years of age. An income tax payer for a period of at least 3 years before the appointment.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The candidate appointed after selection will receive fees and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules, 2026. The notice does not print an amount. Appointees may perform their duties up to a maximum age of 60 years. The appointment is made from a panel prepared for the Bharuch District Court.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Collector Office Bharuch Additional Public Prosecutor
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the office website bharuch.nic.in (the same format is printed in the notice, addressed to the District Magistrate, Bharuch, with the subject "Regarding appointment of Additional Public Prosecutor"). Fill in complete details in the form and affix a recent passport-size photograph, signed by the candidate, in the box given. Attach certified copies of the certificates of date of birth, experience and educational qualification. Attach the income tax returns of the last three years. List the attached certified copies in the enclosures table (serial numbers 1 to 10) at the end of the form. Send the application form only by Speed Post to the Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, District Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001, so that it reaches the office by 23 November 2026. Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will not be considered. Recent passport-size photograph signed by the candidate Certified copy of the date of birth certificate Certified copies of educational qualification certificates Copy of the Sanad (registration as advocate) Certificate from the court where practice started, and experience proof Copies of income tax returns filed for the last three years Proofs of any other qualification claimed

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for an interview. When called, candidates must attend at their own expense with their original certificates at the fixed date, time and place. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Additional Public Prosecutor posts are there in Bharuch?
faq.answer: There are 9 (nine) Additional Public Prosecutor posts, to be filled through a panel for the Bharuch District Court.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Bharuch by 23 November 2026; late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Additional Public Prosecutor post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be law graduates who have been active as advocates for at least seven years and income tax payers for at least 3 years before the appointment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must be not less than 30 years and not more than 55 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an Additional Public Prosecutor in Bharuch?
faq.answer: Appointees receive fees and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from bharuch.nic.in, fill it in, attach the certified copies and last three years' income tax returns, and send it only by Speed Post to the Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, First Floor, District Seva Sadan, Bharuch – 392001.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be called for an interview, which they must attend at their own expense with original certificates at the date, time and place fixed by the office.

faq.question: Q8. Can the application be sent by courier or handed in personally?
faq.answer: The notice says the application form must be sent only by Speed Post.

faq.question: Q9. Up to what age can an Additional Public Prosecutor serve?
faq.answer: Appointees may perform their duties up to a maximum age of 60 years.
